purpose: Schedule the governed P18-P26 completion programme in parallel where independent national pipelines are already defensible, without changing phase semantics, the 20,115-slot denominator, evidence standards or final acceptance gates.
invariants: P18-P26 phase IDs, outputs and acceptance gates remain authoritative in data/data-completion-roadmap.json.
Parallel execution may resolve only slot instances already present in the canonical completeness ledger.
No accelerator or pilot creates a second denominator or a duplicate governed slot.

No county value may be inherited into a constituency and no constituency/county value may be inherited into a ward unless an indicator policy explicitly permits a transparent derived cross-level measure.
Primary official sources remain preferred and all promoted observations retain source, reference period, unit, geography and derivation metadata.
A pilot may leave a governed slot unresolved when evidence or geography is insufficient; it must never fabricate completion.
Full phase completion still requires the original phase acceptance gate even if some of its slots were resolved earlier by an accelerator.
P24 cannot claim completion before full P23 acceptance, and P26 remains the final convergence gate.

local_derivation_priority.goal: Maximise constituency and ward coverage from existing county and national evidence wherever a genuine lower-level derivation can be reproduced without copying parent values.
allowed_methods: direct official constituency or ward observations
exact official child-row aggregation into the target geography
point-in-polygon aggregation of source-backed facilities or services to authoritative target geometries
area or other physical derivation from authoritative geometry
ratio/rate/density calculation from independently sourced target-level numerators and denominators
explicit official crosswalk or allocation formula where the source itself defines the lower-level allocation
prohibited_methods: copying one county value to every constituency or ward in that county
copying one constituency value to every child ward
population-weighting a county rate downward without source-backed target-level numerator/denominator inputs
forcing ambiguous Mandera East/Lafey geometry assignments
reverse-engineering values from maps, charts or rounded display components
priority_order: land area and other geometry-native measures
registered voters and election measures from official ward/constituency schedules
population and household measures where KNBS publishes target-level tables
health-facility and school/service counts from source-backed point or establishment records
facility/school/service densities using target-level population denominators
other county indicators only where an independently reproducible target-level derivation contract exists
acceptance: Every derived local observation identifies its target-level numerator/source rows, denominator where applicable, boundary vintage and derivation method.
Derived child values reconcile back to the authoritative parent total when the measure is additive and boundary-compatible.
No child observation is created solely because a parent observation exists.
Known spatial holds remain unresolved rather than force-matched.

tracks.label: County completion
tracks.rule: P21 and P22 are closed. P22 remains refreshable when newer official drought, food-security or climate evidence supersedes its governed evidence-constrained snapshot, but it no longer blocks constituency completion.

tracks.label: Local intelligence accelerator
tracks.rule: P23 is now the current documented completion phase. Promote reusable national constituency pipelines only into existing P23 slots and retain full 290-constituency reconciliation as the phase acceptance gate. Prioritise target-level derivations from existing county/national source families before adding unrelated new indicators.

tracks.label: Final convergence
tracks.rule: Ward completion, final public-surface closure and the permanent 100% gate retain their original dependencies and acceptance semantics. P24 must maximise source-backed ward derivations before governed closure states are used.

P23A.name: Constituency national-pipeline pilot
P23A.goal: Prove reusable, nationally reconcilable constituency pipelines as the opening tranches of P23.
initial_pipeline_order: official turnout history where citable and comparable
population/household measures from official KNBS target-level tables where available
health-facility and school/service aggregation where source points/establishments and boundary contracts are defensible
NG-CDF utilisation or implementation only where a nationally comparable official source exists

first_tranche.source_family: IEBC 2022 General Election registered-voter Gazette Notice No. 7290
first_tranche.statistical_authority_schedule: First Schedule — Registered Voters per County Assembly Ward
first_tranche.published_constituency_schedule: Second Schedule — Registered Voters per Constituency
first_tranche.canonical_treatment: B — Official derived; exact sum of all official IEBC child ward rows for each constituency, including source rows withheld only from uncertain ward geometry
first_tranche.readiness: 290/290 constituency totals, source authority, anti-inheritance and boundary-hold treatment are governed by a dedicated P23 promotion-readiness contract. The 290 canonical observations map to 870 pre-existing completeness slot instances because the indicator is cross-listed on overview, people and representation surfaces.

acceptance: Only primary/official or explicitly governed extraction artifacts with primary-source authority may support promoted values.
All promoted constituency rows reconcile to the canonical 290-constituency geography registry.
Registered-voter constituency values preserve the audited B — Official derived Sprint 2 treatment unless a separate direct-schedule ingestion is independently validated.
Election and boundary vintage are explicit.
Only pre-existing P23 governed slot instances are resolved; total_slots remains 20,115.
Any partial or unresolved mapping remains visibly unresolved rather than being force-matched.
Each promoted family has a deterministic builder and validator.
Full Atlas build, validation and P16 gates pass before merge.

next_actions: Use data/p23/constituency-voter-promotion-contract.json as the first P23 promotion authority and verify the pinned IEBC extraction against all 290 canonical constituency geographies and the 870 existing P23 voter slot instances across overview, people and representation.

Native-promote exactly 290 constituency registered-voter observations as B — Official derived values without changing the 20,115-slot denominator; rebuild completeness and require exactly 870 P23 slot instances to resolve.

Then run a cascade-first P23 inventory: for every county indicator, test whether an official target-level table, exact child-row aggregation, source-backed point/service aggregation, geometry derivation, or target-level numerator/denominator calculation can create a genuine constituency observation.

Prioritise currently advertised local gaps: constituency population, constituency household size, and constituency/ward health-facility density, but promote only where their target-level source/denominator contracts are independently defensible.
Proceed to official constituency turnout history where period and boundary vintage are explicit and comparable.
Build the current MP identity roster from an official parliamentary source before NG-CDF tranches.
After P23 acceptance, repeat the same cascade-first inventory for P24 wards before using closure states.
Do not force the ten Mandera East/Lafey ward geometry holds; keep them explicit until authoritative reconciliation.
